payload.posture: Read Acts 10:1–23 as one movement in Peter's story, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states cornelius receives instructions while Peter sees a repeated vision, objects, hears a reply, and meets the arriving messengers. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of Peter's story.
